blind.description: An organic lair or funnel-web structure made of fibrous, parchment-like grey webbing. It features a concave upper funnel with pointed rim peaks, anchored to the ground by multiple splayed, root-like tendrils ending in rounded nubs. At the front is a large circular tube-like entrance tunnel, with an exposed rib cage embedded in the web wall beside it, and a small skull-like bone detail embedded on the opposite side.
blind.from_above: A central concave basin with a polygonal rim, surrounded by radiating anchor tendrils resembling an organic starburst or splayed creature, showing the tunnel opening at the bottom and an embedded rib cage to the left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.5 to 3 ft tall), and about 4 to 5 ft wide across its splayed leg anchors.
